units.function: Real-PostgreSQL tests for privacy-minimized interaction.resolved product telemetry across accepted, rejected, answered and expired interaction outcomes.
units.dependencyDirection: Vitest -> real issueThreadInteractionService/PostgreSQL -> mocked telemetry client; hashing exists on the client seam, but asserted events use categorical dimensions and counts rather than entity references.
units.keyDataModels: Interaction kind/status/resolution reason; creator/resolver kind; raw creator Agent role; continuation and target type; created/skipped task, option/selection and question/answer counts; excluded interaction/Agent/Run/comment/document/revision IDs and free text.
units.lifecycle: Persist and resolve/expire interaction -> derive categorical/count analytics dimensions -> send interaction.resolved event while omitting request/answer/reason text and raw operational identifiers.
units.testAssessment: All 7 tests skipped in sandboxed and approved unsandboxed runs because embedded PostgreSQL was unavailable. Intended coverage is strong on several explicit negative fields, but lacks item-verdict/tool-action/addressee adversaries, malicious free-form roles, event schema/version/cardinality, duplicate transitions, telemetry disabled/failure/latency and deployment consent/export behavior.
units.designRationale: Measure how structured interactions are used and resolved without exporting their prompts, answers, rejection reasons or raw entity IDs.
units.companyOsProblem: Company OS needs optional privacy-preserving product analytics that cannot bypass enterprise data-export contracts, especially for Chinese/self-hosted customers, and must never be confused with immutable responsibility evidence.
units.companyOsFit: ADAPT explicit allowlisted categorical/count events and negative leak tests. Replace raw role with a controlled role-category code or deployment-scoped pseudonym; version schemas and enforce cardinality budgets; run every event through DataExportPolicy/consent/region/retention; self-hosted off by default; test hostile prompts, roles, addressees, verdicts, tool metadata and Connector errors; deduplicate via outbox event ID and isolate sink failure.
units.responsibilityConflict: Analytics omits the actual decision content and therefore cannot establish accountability; the raw customer-defined creator_agent_role may itself contain personal or confidential information. No export contract or responsible human consent is demonstrated.
units.securityFindings: CRITICAL Company OS governance requirement: no DataExportPolicy, consent, region, retention or self-hosted default is tested. HIGH free-form leakage risk: creator_agent_role is exported raw. HIGH coverage gap: tool action, addressee and item-verdict metadata are not tested against leakage. HIGH verification gap: all real-database tests skipped. MEDIUM reliability gap: duplicate emission, sink failure and schema/version behavior are absent. POSITIVE: explicit negative assertions exclude raw IDs, prompts, answers, summaries, decline reasons, comment and document/revision references.
